nodes.name: calls
nodes.description: Call edges inside functions, methods and class bodies, with how the callee was resolved. Direct call sites are all kept; those without an internal callee have a null callee and are classified as builtin, external, dynamic_attribute or unresolved. Callback rows record an internal function or method passed by reference as an argument to another call, e.g. asyncio.to_thread(f, x).

nodes.name: class_bases
nodes.description: Base classes named in each class statement, in order, with the internal class each one resolves to.

nodes.name: files
nodes.description: One row per analysed Python source file.

nodes.name: headings
nodes.description: Fixed headings and contract atoms found in module docstrings, verbatim.

nodes.name: imports
nodes.description: Import statements, one row per imported name, with the internal file each resolves to.

nodes.name: inbound_call_counts
nodes.description: Every symbol with the number of resolved direct call sites that target it, the number of callback references to it, and the number of distinct callers of either kind.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.description: One row identifying the analysed source: repository, commit, content fingerprint, builder and its known limits.

nodes.name: symbols
nodes.description: Functions, methods and classes defined in the analysed files.

nodes.name: test_links
nodes.description: Static links from test files to the source files they exercise.

nodes.name: untested_public_symbols
nodes.description: Public symbols in non-test files whose file no test file links to.

queries:
WITH RECURSIVE impact(symbol_id, depth) AS (
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, 1
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN code.symbols t ON t.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id
  WHERE t.name = 'resolve_semantic_fks'
  UNION
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, i.depth + 1
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN impact i ON c.callee_symbol_id = i.symbol_id
  WHERE i.depth < 6
)
SELECT i.symbol_id, s.file_id, f.is_test, MIN(i.depth) AS depth
FROM impact i
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = i.symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
GROUP BY i.symbol_id, s.file_id, f.is_test
ORDER BY depth, i.symbol_id

SELECT c.callee_name, COUNT(*) AS call_sites
FROM code.calls c
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
WHERE c.resolution = 'unresolved' AND NOT f.is_test
GROUP BY c.callee_name
ORDER BY call_sites DESC, c.callee_name
LIMIT 50

WITH RECURSIVE impact(symbol_id, depth) AS (
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, 1
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN code.symbols t ON t.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id
  WHERE t.name = 'resolve_semantic_fks'
  UNION
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, i.depth + 1
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN impact i ON c.callee_symbol_id = i.symbol_id
  WHERE i.depth < 6
)
SELECT i.symbol_id, s.file_id, f.is_test, MIN(i.depth) AS depth
FROM impact i
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = i.symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
GROUP BY i.symbol_id, s.file_id, f.is_test
ORDER BY depth, i.symbol_id

SELECT c.callee_name, COUNT(*) AS call_sites
FROM code.calls c
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
WHERE c.resolution = 'unresolved' AND NOT f.is_test
GROUP BY c.callee_name
ORDER BY call_sites DESC, c.callee_name
LIMIT 50

SELECT i.imported_file_id AS file_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.file_id) AS importers
FROM code.imports i
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = i.imported_file_id
WHERE NOT f.is_test AND i.file_id <> i.imported_file_id
GROUP BY i.imported_file_id
ORDER BY importers DESC, file_id
LIMIT 50

SELECT v.symbol_id, v.kind, v.inbound_calls, v.callback_references, v.distinct_callers
FROM code.inbound_call_counts v
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = v.file_id
WHERE NOT f.is_test AND v.inbound_calls > 0
ORDER BY v.inbound_calls DESC, v.symbol_id
LIMIT 50

SELECT c.callee_name, COUNT(*) AS call_sites
FROM code.calls c
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
WHERE c.resolution = 'unresolved' AND NOT f.is_test
GROUP BY c.callee_name
ORDER BY call_sites DESC, c.callee_name
LIMIT 50
